title: Operational risk signals
summary: Upload a participant/study operational signal feed, inspect the transparent weighted heuristic scores and worst-tier levels, and explore labeled signal-level changes. These operational scores are not calibrated probabilities of trial termination.
try: Download blank CSV templates or select your source CSV and map its columns.
Validate the inputs, explore the editable controls and save the complete workspace to retain results.
Load the fictional example only when you want a guided demonstration.
data_scope: Your study inputs · optional fictional example
data_note: No client is preconfigured. Files remain in browser memory; save the complete workspace before closing or reloading.
